_about: Synthetic engagement for the mock adapters. NOT real data. Numbers are rough, platform-typical shapes: Instagram reaches widely with mostly likes, Facebook reaches a little less but draws the most comments, shares and clicks, X reaches fast with the lowest engagement rate. Each post's totals grow toward a final value (63% reached after hours_to_63_percent_reach) and are seeded by post id, so they are repeatable. The patterns below are deliberate, documented effects for the weekly report to discover.

patterns.description: Bengali posts get more engagement than English ones on Instagram.
Facebook posts with more than 3 hashtags get less engagement.
Short X posts (140 weighted characters or fewer, hashtags included) get more clicks.
